title: BUILD-GV2-052-matchup-page-content-model
universal_lens: A content-model specification functor C: Spec → SafeImpl mapping editorial intent to validated, non-production artifacts via a safety monad S = (Test, Gate, Rollback) ⊗ BrandConstraint, where deployment is a forbidden morphism until external approval resolves the adjunction Spec ⊣ Prod.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats each matchup page as a Bayesian evidence node E with prior P(θ|history) updated by conformal prediction sets C_α(x) = {y: p(y|x) ≥ q_α} where α encodes brand-safety thresholds; the content model specifies the likelihood p(E|θ) and the safety gates enforce coverage guarantees.
gse_mapping: GSE models the matchup page as a state-transition system S = (Σ, →, Γ) where Σ = {Draft, Validated, Approved, Live}, → are guarded transitions requiring Test(σ) ∧ Gate(σ) ∧ ¬Leak(σ), and Γ enforces rollback invariants; the content model defines the transition predicates and emission alphabet.

primitives.name: ContentModelSpecificationOperator
primitives.verbatim_quote: parent_id: none supersedes_id: none dependency_ids: none merge_notes: none ## Category content / SEO / editorial ## Goal Build or specify matchup page content model for Galaxy Sports Edge / GSN without changing production systems first.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: EditorialIntent: dimensionless specification vector; ContentModel: structured schema (JSON/AST); SafetyGates: tuple (TestSuite, ApprovalGate, RollbackPlan) each dimensionless boolean predicates
primitives.assumptions: Existing ledger contains no matching build (quote 5); GSE shipping clone is verifiable (quote 12); smallest safe docs-first implementation exists
primitives.breakdown_regime: Specification becomes inconsistent when EditorialIntent requires production data access or live affiliate links (quotes 10, 14)

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE state-transition specification where ContentModel ≡ Σ (state space) and SafetyGates ≡ Γ (transition guards); GSI maps ContentModel to likelihood structure p(E|θ) and SafetyGates to conformal coverage constraints
layer2.telemetry: Schema validation pass rate; gate coverage completeness; rollback drill success rate

primitives.name: SafetyValidationGateOperator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Add tests or validation for event shape, copy safety, privacy, and rollback.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Test_i: predicate returning {0,1}; Gate_i: approval predicate returning {0,1}; i ∈ {event_shape, copy_safety, privacy, rollback} each dimensionless
primitives.assumptions: Tests are pure functions of the content model artifact; no production secrets required; validation runs in isolated environment
primitives.breakdown_regime: Gate fails when any Test_i = 0 or when copy_safety detects method leakage, fake certainty, pressure language, or irresponsible gambling language (quote 11)

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSE transition guard Γ(σ) = ∧_i Gate_i(σ); GSI maps to conformal prediction where each Test_i defines a coverage constraint C_α^i with α_i calibrated to brand-risk tolerance
layer2.telemetry: Per-gate pass/fail rates; false positive rate of copy_safety detector; rollback drill latency

primitives.name: DeploymentProhibitionGateOperator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Stop before production data, public launch, live affiliate links, billing, or deploy.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: σ: system state; Approval: external authorization predicate (dimensionless); path: sequence of guarded transitions; Live: terminal production state
primitives.assumptions: No implicit deployment paths exist in CI/CD; all transitions to Live require explicit Approval = 1; production data access is a separate forbidden transition
primitives.breakdown_regime: Prohibition violated if any transition bypasses Approval gate or if production data leaks into test environment (quotes 7, 10)

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE terminal state invariant Γ(σ_Live) = Approval(σ_Live); GSI maps to decision-theoretic stop rule where expected utility of deployment < 0 without Approval
layer2.telemetry: Number of unauthorized deployment attempts; time-to-detect bypass; approval latency distribution

primitives.name: BrandVoiceConstraintOperator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Copy / Brand Voice Needed Plain human copy, no fake certainty, no pressure, no method leakage, no irresponsible gambling language, and clear disclosure where required.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: c: copy string; each predicate returns {0,1}; Plain: readability score > threshold; FakeCertainty: absence of absolute claims; Pressure: absence of urgency manipulation; Leak: absence of methodology exposure; IrresponsibleGambling: compliance with regulatory lexicon; Disclosure: presence of required legal text
primitives.assumptions: Automated detectors exist for each predicate; thresholds are calibrated; human review is final arbiter
primitives.breakdown_regime: Constraint fails when any predicate = 0; adversarial copy may evade detectors via paraphrase (requires human-in-the-loop)

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSE emission alphabet constraint Γ_emit(c) = C_brand(c); GSI maps to prior regularization where P(θ|brand) ∝ exp(-λ ∑_i violation_i(θ)) with λ → ∞ for hard constraints
layer2.telemetry: Automated detector precision/recall; human override rate; regulatory complaint incidence

reasoning_traces.think:
The specification defines a content model as a structured artifact M produced from editorial intent I via a specification functor M = F(I). The critical mathematical structure is the safety monad S = (T, G, R) where T = {Test_i} are validation predicates, G = {Gate_i} are approval gates, and R is a rollback operator. The deployment prohibition P_deploy creates a terminal state invariant: the Live state is only reachable when Approval = 1. This forms a guarded transition system Σ = {Draft, Validated, Approved, Live} with transitions guarded by ∧_i Gate_i. The brand voice constraint C_brand acts as an emission filter on the output alphabet. GSI mapping: each matchup page is an evidence node with likelihood p(E|θ) defined by M; conformal prediction sets C_α enforce coverage where α encodes brand-safety thresholds. GSE mapping: the content model specifies the state space Σ and transition guards Γ. Failure modes: (1) specification inconsistency when I requires forbidden production access; (2) gate bypass via CI/CD misconfiguration; (3) adversarial copy evading automated detectors; (4) rollback failure under load. The duality between specification (syntax) and validation (semantics) is mediated by the safety monad.
